# aether_audit_log (Data Source)

Returns only the newest `limit` events. The platform's cursor pagination beyond the first page is unreliable today (aether-api issue), so this data source does not page. `ip_address` is taken from the client's `X-Forwarded-For` header and is not authoritative.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Returns ONE page: the newest `limit` events (1-100); older events are not paged.
data "aether_audit_log" "recent" {
  limit = 100
}

output "recent_actions" {
  value = [for e in data.aether_audit_log.recent.events : "${e.created_at} ${e.actor_email} ${e.action}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Number of newest events to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

### Read-Only

- `events` (Attributes List) The newest events, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) What happened (free text, e.g. `registry.disable`).
- `actor_email` (String) Email of a `user` actor who is still a member; null otherwise.
- `actor_id` (String) UUID of the actor; null when none was recorded.
- `actor_type` (String) `user`, `api_token` or `system`.
- `created_at` (String) Event time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Event UUID.
- `ip_address` (String) Client address from `X-Forwarded-For`; not authoritative. Null when none was recorded.
- `metadata_json` (String) Event metadata as compact JSON text (use `jsondecode`); null when the event has none.
- `resource_id` (String) UUID of the resource acted on; null when none was recorded.
- `resource_type` (String) Kind of resource acted on (free text).
